title: Auseinandersetzung im Volkspark – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht

extraction.summaryEn: A dispute at Volkspark Hasenheide escalated when a man from a group allegedly stabbed a 60-year-old who had tried to mediate. His 48-year-old friend, who came to help, was also stabbed; both were seriously injured and a homicide unit is investigating attempted killings.
